question: 새어 나오는 악몽은 너프됐어 버프됐어?
gold_cypher: MATCH (t:maple__Skill {rdfs__label:'새어 나오는 악몽'})<-[:maple__changes]-(c:maple__PatchChange)-[:maple__changeType]->(ct), (c)-[:maple__inPatch]->(p) RETURN t.rdfs__label AS target, c.maple__attribute AS attribute, c.maple__beforeValue AS before, c.maple__afterValue AS after, replace(ct.uri,'https://example.org/maple#','') AS change_type, toString(p.maple__patchDate) AS patch_date
